name: VNX British Pound
oneLiner: VGBP is VNX Global Ltd.'s institutional GBP token, backed by Apex-attested GBP cash at Bermuda Commercial Bank.
collateral: GBP cash held by VNX Global Ltd. in a designated reserve account at Bermuda Commercial Bank, separately maintained from operating accounts; Apex's August 2026 attestation reconciles GBP 126,596.33 of cash to GBP 126,595.48 of VGBP liabilities on Solana, Celo, and Base
pegMechanism: VNX Global Ltd. mints VGBP against GBP funding and offers at-par redemption to verified institutional customers. The published minimum transaction threshold is GBP 100,000; fiat settlement averages approximately one business day through direct cancellation against reserves or issuer buyback, subject to eligibility, compliance, liquidity conditions, and the VNX Global Terms
